name: Infomaniak AI Provider
description: A Infomaniak AI provider for the Drupal AI module.
project_description:
The Infomaniak AI Provider module integrates ai-tools with Drupal's AI module, bringing open-source AI models. This provider enables European AI with a focus on data sovereignty, privacy, and environmental responsibility.

 Features 
 
 Chat & Text Generation 
 Text Embeddings 
 Image Generation 
 Image Editing 
 Seamless Integration: Works with all AI module ecosystem modules 
 
 Available Models 
 Chat 
 
 Llama 3.3 - Meta's latest open-source model 
 Granite 3.1 8B - IBM's enterprise AI 
 Mistral Small 3.2 24B 
 Qwen3 VL 235B - Vision-language multimodal model 
 Gemma 3n E4B - Google's compact model 
 Apertus 70B Instruct - Swiss AI high-performance 
 GPT-OSS 120B - Large open-source model 
 
 Embedding 
 
 BGE Multilingual Gemma2 - 3584-dim multilingual 
 All MiniLM L12 v2 - 384-dim fast embeddings 
 Qwen3 Embedding 8B - 4096-dim high-quality 
 
 Image Generation 
 
 Flux Schnell - Fast, high-quality image generation 
 
 Post-Installation 
 1. Get your Infomaniak credentials:

 
 Log in to https://manager.infomaniak.com/ 
 Create an API token with ai-tools scope 
 Copy your Product ID from Cloud Computing → AI Tools 
 
 2. Configure in Drupal:

 
 Navigate to /admin/config/ai/providers/infomaniak 
 Enter your API token and Product ID 
 Click "Test Connection" to verify 
 Save configuration 
 
 3. Start using AI:

 
 Your models are now available throughout the AI module ecosystem 
 Use for chat, embeddings, image generation, and more 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10.3+ or Drupal 11+ 
 PHP 8.1+ 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/ai (^1.2.4) 
 https://www.drupal.org/project/key (recommended for secure API key storage) 
 Active Infomaniak account with AI Tools subscription 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 Contribute to the AI ecosystem: Support ongoing development through https://opencollective.com/drupal-ai .
